ideas.name: Monthly Forward Discount Carry
ideas.claim: Lustig, Roussanov and Verdelhan document a return spread between high- and low-interest-rate currency portfolios.
ideas.quote: Portfolios are rebalanced at the end of every month.

rules.market: Developed-country currencies versus USD, including FX majors; the published universe extends beyond majors.
rules.entry: At month-end, sort currencies by log forward discount, log(F)-log(S), with both quotes in foreign currency per USD. Buy the highest-discount portfolio and sell the lowest-discount portfolio; average currency returns equally within each portfolio.
rules.exit: Sell purchased foreign currency in the spot market after one month; rebalance monthly.
rules.filters: Require current and subsequent-period spot and forward observations. Replace euro-area legacy currencies with EUR from January 1999.

ideas.claimed_result: Table 1 reports developed-country highest-minus-lowest annualized mean log excess returns of 3.09% after bid-ask spreads, with Sharpe ratio 0.32, November 1983–December 2009.

report.what_done: Ran all three requested searches and extracted one idea from an opened paper. NBER Carry pages returned HTTP 403 and were not used.
open_questions: Majors-only portfolio specification and stop are not stated.
